# VELIX Web Solutions

> VELIX Web Solutions (فيلكس) is a web design and development company based in Amman, Jordan. It designs and builds custom, bilingual Arabic/English company websites, landing pages, online stores and web systems for small and medium businesses in Jordan and the Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait). Founder & CEO: Moatsm Abdeen, who has delivered 79+ projects since he started working in web development.

Key facts:
- Location: Amman, Jordan. Serves all of Jordan (Amman, Irbid, Zarqa, Aqaba) in person and the Gulf remotely.
- Services: company websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores, booking systems and admin dashboards, UI/UX design, SEO and performance, website security and maintenance.
- Languages: Arabic and English, with proper RTL/LTR layouts. Sites are custom-designed and hand-coded, not templates.
- Starting prices: landing page from 200 JD, business website from 350 JD, online store from 400 JD. Final price is confirmed in writing after a free consultation; payment 50% at start, 50% at launch.
- Timelines depend on scope, complexity and requirements; a written proposal and scope of work come before any work starts.
- Contact: hello@velixweb.xyz, WhatsApp +962 79 969 1748, free consultation booking at https://velixweb.xyz/book.html
